data.body: [P2] Approach: Resolve the redundant lifecycle guards under rule 4. Both terminate and close synchronously clear `suspendAfterJob`, and job completion refuses to create another request after either flag is set. Consequently, the earlier undefined-request check already returns in both states; these operands cannot protect a reachable case, and the termination/close tests still pass without them. Rule 4 explicitly excludes defensive branches for impossible cases. Return to the design phase under rule 8 and choose one lifecycle rule that owns cancellation of pending requests.
